messages:
mina: Noticed recurring PCIe stalls on eu-north rack-11 during nightly large-exports. 95p token latency spikes 100ms -> 2s after midnight. dash: https://dash.redwood/eu-north/rack-11

oliver: Any host-level signs? pci_retrain, dma_error, nic_txq?

mina: pci_retrain increments on host eu-north-3c-rack-11. NIC tx queues hit 100% when imagetools and analytics both export parallel blobs.

alloc-bot: Autoscaler: tenant=imagetools pool=shared-gpu-eu-north slots=10 -> +4 at 1746912000

rahul: Quick mitigation: apply proxy policer to cap sustained export to 150MB/s, allow 32MB burst. Also prefer newer-rack placement for heavy exporters.

mina: Runbook snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/policer -d '{"tenant":"imagetools","rate_mb":150,"burst_mb":32}'
```

alloc-bot: Probe applied -> egress reduced from 420MB/s to ~160MB/s on rack-11 at 1746912380

oliver: early signal: pci_retrain dropped to baseline and 95p down to ~180ms. good sign.

rahul: Next steps:
- Mina: monitor 60m, capture traces for KV-warmup differences
- Oliver: tag rack-11 as "legacy-pcie" in placement service to avoid future carveouts there
- Ops: prepare short canary dedicated slice on newer racks if this recurs

mina: I'll leave policer for 1h and report. filing incident INC-4589.

oliver: thanks, will follow up with placement tag PR. :thumbsup:
